items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: I didn't know he ever played with Ben Pollack.

ctx.x: Is she? Yeah. And I think she has possession of one of his horns, you know, his cornets. One of his cornets is down in the Jazz Museum in New Orleans. I guess it was one he played with Ben Pollack for a short time, when he was playing with Ben Pollack.
I didn't know he ever played with Ben Pollack. I don't either, but...
I don't think he did ever play with Ben Pollack. Yeah. But, uh...
